flagshippioneeringinc-flagshippioneering.title: Senior IT Project Leader
flagshippioneeringinc-flagshippioneering.description: Who We Are Flagship Pioneering is a biotechnology company that invents and builds platform companies that change the world. We bring together the greatest scientific minds with entrepreneurial company builders and assemble the capital to allow them to take courageous leaps. Those big leaps in human health and sustainability exponentially accelerate scientific progress in areas ranging from cancer detection and treatment to nature-positive agriculture. What sets Flagship apart is our ability to advance biotechnology by uniting life science innovation, company creation, and capital investment under one roof in a way that is largely without precedent. Our scientific founders, entrepreneurial leaders, and professional capital managers are each aligned around an institutionalized process that enables us to innovate and transform for the benefit of people and planet. Many of the companies Flagship has founded have addressed humanity’s most urgent challenges: vaccinating billions of people against COVID-19, curing intractable diseases, improving human health, preempting illness, and feeding the world by improving the resiliency and sustainability of agriculture. Flagship has been recognized twice on FORTUNE’s “Change the World” list, an annual ranking of companies that have made a positive social and environmental impact through activities that are part of their core business strategies, and has been twice named to Fast Company’s annual list of the World’s Most Innovative Companies. Position Overview Flagship is seeking an experienced Senior IT Project Leader to drive strategic technology initiatives across the enterprise. This role is ideal for a collaborative leader who thrives in ambiguity, builds strong cross-functional partnerships, and enjoys turning complex ideas into successful outcomes. Reporting to the Senior Director of IT Performance, the Project Leader will partner with technical teams, business stakeholders, and executive leadership to deliver initiatives aligned with Flagship's strategy. Projects may span enterprise applications, infrastructure, cloud, cybersecurity, AI, scientific systems, and other strategic IT capabilities. Rather than simply managing timelines, the Project Leader serves as the connective tissue between business strategy and technology execution, bringing people together, aligning priorities, removing obstacles, and ensuring successful delivery. What You'll Do Lead Strategic Technology Initiatives Lead complex, cross-functional technology initiatives from planning through implementation and operational transition. Partner with business and IT leaders to define project objectives, scope, success measures, and delivery strategies. Develop and manage integrated project plans, schedules, budgets, resource forecasts, and governance activities. Ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and aligned with organizational priorities. Drive Cross-Functional Leadership Build trusted partnerships with business leaders, technical teams, and executive stakeholders. Facilitate collaboration across multiple departments, vendors, and external partners. Lead steering committee meetings, executive updates, and project governance forums. Create alignment among diverse stakeholders while driving timely decision-making. Manage Complexity and Risk Anticipate and proactively manage project risks, issues, dependencies, and scope changes. Resolve delivery challenges by balancing business priorities, technical constraints, and organizational impacts. Ensure project decisions are made by data, risk assessments, and strategic objectives. Drive organizational readiness, communications, and change management activities to support successful adoption. Advance Delivery Excellence Champion consistent project management practices, governance standards, and delivery methodologies. Develop executive-level reporting and portfolio insights that enable informed decision-making. Identify opportunities to improve project delivery

jobgether-jobgether:lever:1282e875-f6d6-.title: Project Manager with Agile and Scrum
jobgether-jobgether:lever:1282e875-f6d6-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Project Manager with Agile and Scrum based in India. This role is designed for an experienced project leader with strong expertise in Agile and Scrum delivery. You will oversee projects from planning through execution, ensuring teams remain aligned with business objectives and delivery commitments. The position combines Scrum Master responsibilities, project governance, stakeholder engagement, and risk management. You will work with distributed teams and contribute to global rollouts across multiple geographies. The role also involves facilitating Agile ceremonies, managing sprint execution, and tracking delivery through clear metrics. It is well suited to a seasoned professional who can lead large teams while fostering effective Agile practices. Manage end-to-end project delivery, leveraging Agile and Scrum practices to ensure projects are completed according to agreed timelines, scope, quality, and objectives. Act as Scrum Master and Agile Practitioner, facilitating Scrum ceremonies including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and backlog-related activities. Lead sprint planning and execution, ensuring stories are clearly understood, appropriately prioritized, and progressing according to the delivery plan. Create and maintain burndown charts and daily tracking mechanisms to monitor sprint progress, including delivery across multiple stories and team members. Coordinate project planning activities, defining milestones, dependencies, resources, delivery plans, and execution strategies. Manage risks, issues, dependencies, and impediments, proactively identifying challenges and driving appropriate mitigation and resolution. Manage relationships with business stakeholders, delivery teams, leadership, and other project participants, ensuring transparent communication throughout the project lifecycle. Lead and coordinate teams of 20+ professionals, promoting collaboration, accountability, and effective Agile delivery. Support global project rollouts across multiple geographies, adapting delivery approaches to different teams, stakeholders, and operational contexts. Coach teams on Agile principles, Scrum practices, continuous improvement, and effective delivery habits; Agile coaching experience is an advantage. Track project and sprint performance, communicate progress to stakeholders, and provide visibility into delivery risks and expected outcomes. Requirements: More than 10 years of total professional experience, including at least 4 years of dedicated project management experience. Minimum 4 years of hands-on experience working as a Scrum Master and Agile Practitioner. Recognized Scrum/Agile certification such as Certified ScrumMaster (CSM) or SAFe Agilist. Strong practical knowledge of Scrum frameworks, Agile methodologies, sprint management, backlog coordination, and Agile ceremonies. Proven experience with project planning, delivery tracking, risk management, stakeholder management, and issue resolution. Experience managing teams of 20 or more professionals, with demonstrated leadership and coordination capabilities. Experience supporting or managing global rollouts across multiple geographies. Strong understanding of Agile metrics, including burndown charts, sprint progress, delivery tracking, and team performance indicators. Excellent communication, facilitation, stakeholder management, organization, and problem-solving skills. Ability to operate effectively in complex environments, manage competing priorities, and maintain delivery focus. Agile Coach experience is an advantage. PMP certification is an added advantage. Benefits: Full-time project opportunity under a Contract-to-Hire (C2H) model. Opportunity to work on global projects involving distributed teams and multiple geographies. jobgether-jobgether:lever:344de36c-a024-.title: Head of Operations for eCom DTC brand
jobgether-jobgether:lever:344de36c-a024-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Head of Operations for eCom DTC brand based in United States. This is a high-impact operations leadership role within a fast-growing, 8-figure direct-to-consumer business. You will take ownership of the operating infrastructure that supports supply chain, inventory, fulfillment, systems, reporting, hiring, and execution. The role is designed for a hands-on builder who can turn operational complexity into clear processes, accountable ownership, and measurable performance. You will identify gaps, build SOPs, establish systems, recruit functional leaders, and create the structure needed for sustainable scale. A major focus will be transitioning day-to-day operational responsibility away from the Founder and toward a capable team of independent functional owners. You will work across distributed teams, vendors, agencies, manufacturers, and operational partners in a highly entrepreneurial environment. Success means building an organization that runs efficiently, solves problems proactively, and no longer depends on you for daily execution. Own end-to-end back-end operations, including supply chain, inventory planning, manufacturing relationships, 3PL and fulfillment, returns, vendor management, and agency coordination. Build and maintain scalable operating systems, processes, and SOPs, ensuring every recurring workflow has clear ownership, documentation, measurement, and accountability. Establish and maintain an operational knowledge base in Notion, continuously improving processes as the business grows and new needs emerge. Develop accurate inventory systems of record, purchase-order calendars, and processes that improve inventory visibility, planning, and stock availability. Build reliable reporting and a single source of truth for weekly leadership metrics, including inventory, stockouts, cost per order, channel and subscription revenue, vendor performance, and other operational KPIs. Create automated subscription and channel revenue reporting and develop a concise weekly operations scorecard for leadership decision-making. Establish vendor and agency scorecards to monitor performance, identify issues, and drive continuous improvement. Identify missing organizational functions, define roles and scorecards, lead recruitment, conduct screening, onboard new hires, and develop functional owners. Build a team of 4–6 functional leaders who can independently own their respective areas and operate without daily intervention. Create repeatable hiring pipelines, work-sample assessments, onboarding systems, and accountability mechanisms. Translate decisions into clear written specifications with defined owners, deadlines, and completion criteria, then follow through until execution is complete. Diagnose operational issues by tracing performance changes back to their underlying causes and implementing sustainable solutions. Continuously identify and resolve operational problems before they escalate into Founder-level issues. Build the infrastructure and organizational capability required to ultimately transition into broader COO-level responsibilities. Requirements At least 3 years of operations experience within a physical-product, e-commerce, or direct-to-consumer business. Experience operating within a high-growth environment, ideally supporting or helping scale a brand generating approximately $20M–$50M in annual revenue. Direct experience across multiple operational functions, including supply chain, inventory, 3PL/fulfillment, customer support operations, creative, and growth teams. Demonstrated experience building a department, function, operating system, hiring process, reporting infrastructure, or other business capability from the ground up. You will take ownership of complex operational challenges and translate business needs into scalable product solutions. Working closely with cross-functional teams, you will help improve processes, systems, automation, and data-driven decision-making. jobgether-jobgether:lever:6840594d-9eb7-.title: Acquisitions Manager | Home Buying Specialist
jobgether-jobgether:lever:6840594d-9eb7-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Acquisitions Manager | Home Buying Specialist based in Greece. This is a high-impact sales role at the heart of a fast-moving real estate acquisitions team. You’ll connect directly with property sellers, build trust, assess opportunities, and guide deals from initial conversation through closing. Your sales expertise will be central to negotiating attractive agreements while creating a positive experience for sellers. The role is designed for proven high-ticket sales professionals, including those transitioning into real estate from other industries. You’ll work closely with marketing and closing teams while staying informed on market trends and property values. With uncapped commission potential and structured onboarding support, the position rewards initiative, strong negotiation, and consistent performance. It’s a fully remote opportunity for an ambitious closer who wants significant ownership and earning potential. Engage with seller leads generated through marketing initiatives, building rapport and establishing trust throughout the sales process. Assess properties and gather relevant information to support accurate valuations and informed acquisition decisions. Lead negotiations with property sellers, applying strong sales and persuasion skills to structure mutually beneficial agreements. Manage deals from initial qualification through contract execution, ensuring a smooth transition to the closing team. Collaborate closely with marketing, acquisitions, and closing colleagues to keep transactions progressing efficiently. Maintain strong communication with sellers throughout the process, delivering a professional and memorable experience. Monitor real estate market conditions, trends, and relevant opportunities to strengthen competitiveness and decision-making. Build lasting relationships with sellers while consistently working toward acquisition, revenue, and performance targets. Requirements: At least 2 years of successful high-ticket sales experience , ideally within real estate, luxury goods, financial services, or another high-value sales environment. A proven track record of exceeding sales targets and consistently closing complex or high-value deals. Strong negotiation, objection-handling, and closing abilities, with confidence guiding prospects toward a decision. Excellent verbal and written communication skills, combined with a natural ability to establish rapport and build trusted relationships. Strong self-motivation and a results-oriented mindset, with the ability to work independently in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment. Comfortable using CRM platforms and modern sales technology to manage leads, follow-ups, and opportunities. Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams while maintaining ownership of your deals. A real estate license is welcome but not required . Bilingual English/Spanish communication skills are a plus. Benefits: Base salary of approximately $2,000–$3,000 USD per month. Potential total earnings of up to approximately $8,000–$13,000 USD per month after commissions, depending on performance. 12.5% commission per deal with uncapped earning potential. Guaranteed salary during the first three months , providing stability while you transition into the role. Fully 100% remote position. Career growth opportunities within a performance-driven team. A supportive environment with training and tools designed to help successful sales professionals transition into real estate. Opportunity to build expertise in a dynamic and competitive property investment market. summitwashholdings-summitwashholdings:le.description: IMPORTANT - REQUIRED NEXT STEP As part of our hiring process, all applicants are required to complete the Predictive Index (PI) Behavioral Assessment. The PI Behavioral Assessment is not a test, and there are no right or wrong answers. It helps us better understand your natural workplace preferences and behaviors. Please complete the assessment when prompted. Completion is required for your application to move forward in the review process. Benefits, and Perks - Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance - Flexible scheduling - Paid Time Off (PTO) - Career Growth based on Performance and not Seniority – 75% of employees were promoted within Summit Wash Holdings - Referral Bonus up to $800.00 per qualified hire, dependent on position - Free Car Wash Membership Who are we? Summit Wash Holdings is a premier group of car wash brands growing throughout the Northeast, Midwest, and Southeast regions. At Summit Wash Holdings, all teammates produce speedy service in a fun and mutually respectful manner with gold-standard integrity, quality, and hospitality, all while maintaining a work-life balance. Our Mission is to provide a fast, quality car wash with friendly-spirited engagement and integrity. What do we need? The Entry Ride Operator is the conductor and entertainer for our members while making sure all vehicles are being processed safely and efficiently into the car wash tunnel. The Entry Ride Operator interacts with all customers and is responsible for exterior site cleanliness and creating a memorable experience in all interactions while preparing the vehicles prior to entering the car wash tunnel. A successful candidate would love working outdoors in all conditions and will be excited to roll up their sleeves to get the job done! You must be highly motivated, have an outgoing, and a friendly personality. We will provide extensive hands-on and online training for all team members. Location: Speeders Car Wash (Hamilton) 1266 Rt 33 ,Hamilton Township, NJ 08690
